china_race_dynamics.text: But I'm going to tell you, this is our modern-day space race, our modern-day arms race. This is so meaningful to American prosperity and national security that we're leading this. And putting in anything that's going to start slowing this down, I think, is the wrong message right now because our adversaries are not going to do that.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls AI a modern arms race and says slowing it down is the wrong message because adversaries will not slow down.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The race framing and opposition to slowing down are explicit, though the speed-over-safety facet is inferred from the broad warning against slowdowns.

china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial intelligence really is the modern-day arms race, and there's going to be winners and losers in this. And right now it's the United States versus China.

deepseek.reason: The speaker explicitly frames AI as an arms race between the United States and China with winners and losers.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly endorses the China AI race framing, though it does not call for a specific policy action.
